turns.doctor_question: Hello, welcome. What brings you in today?
turns.patient_response: Hello. Well, I'm here because I just can't seem to turn off my worrying. Once it starts, it just keeps going. Even when I tell myself I’ve made the lists, checked all the dates, and done everything I reasonably can to handle things, I still can't get my mind to stop fretting about it.

turns.doctor_question: How long has this pattern of worrying been going on?
turns.patient_response: I'd say it's been going on for about seven months now. It started shortly after a friend of mine passed away. We had some projects we were doing together, and I tried to just... keep them moving along on my own after she died. That's really when all this started.

turns.doctor_question: Are your worries mainly about your friend’s death and the projects you shared, or do they also occur about many other areas of your life?

turns.doctor_question: Before your friend died, did you have a similar pattern of worrying about many different areas of your life?
